findings.title: [P2] Defer loading default roots until verified HTTPS is used
findings.suggested_fix: Initialize and load the shared SSLContext on the first verify=True HTTPS request, while preserving one-time initialization for concurrent callers.
findings.why_it_matters: requests imports adapters during normal package import, so every process pays SSLContext creation and CA bundle parsing even if it only makes HTTP requests or never sends a request. The change usefully removes repeated root loading from new verified HTTPS connections, but eagerly moves that work onto all imports; lazy one-time initialization retains the HTTPS amortization without adding startup cost to HTTP-only and import-only users.
evidence: src/requests/adapters.py:303 -- and this avoids a call to the slow load_verify_locations()

residual_risks: A module-global context amortizes default-root loading across verified HTTPS connections; the eager load mainly shifts that cost to process import and affects HTTP-only callers.
testing_gaps: No startup/import or repeated-connection performance measurements were available, so the size of the tradeoff is not quantified.
